{{Quote|This lightsaber was stolen from your Jedi Temple by my ancestors during the fall of the Old Republic. Since then many Jedi have died upon its blade. Prepare yourself to join them!|Pre Vizsla to Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=Darksaber-TMP.flac|<ref name="TMP" />}}
The '''Darksaber''' was an ancient, [[Color/Legends|black]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Unlike most other lightsabers, the Darksaber's blade was nearly flat, thin, and tapered to a point more typical of a traditional metallic [[Sword/Legends|sword]]. The black core of the blade appeared to draw in all surrounding light and color, leaving a faint white, electrical aura along its edges, it hummed with a higher-pitched whine than its more common lightsaber counterparts when the blade was active, and made a sound like a whistle when it was swung. Once held by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], during a period of collapse in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] power, the Darksaber was stolen by members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], the black lightsaber was passed down through generations of the [[Clan Vizsla/Legends|Vizsla clan]], and when [[Tor Vizsla]] founded the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], he chose the Darksaber as the symbol of his authority as the sect's [[Secret Mandalore]].

Upon Tor Vizsla's [[Death/Legends|death]], the ancient blade was entrusted to his clan kinsman [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the current leader of Death Watch, and reigned as the Secret Mandalore well into the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Early in the war, the Darksaber was brought against the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in a [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|duel]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. Vizsla's [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|skill]] with the black blade was such that he could fight evenly with Kenobi for a time. After Death Watch was banished from the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], Vizsla led his people to the planet [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]]. There, the Death Watch leader came into [[Battle on Carlac/Legends|conflict]] with the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] whom Vizsla attempted to kill with the Darksaber. After a short but heated bout, the young Jedi fled from Vizsla, and escaped the world with her life.

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Vizsla led the Death Watch into an alliance with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], assembling a [[Shadow Collective/Legends|criminal army]] with which they were able to [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|bring down]] the [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|leaders]] of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]. When Vizsla betrayed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the wake of their victory, Maul challenged the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|single combat]] for leadership, and upon [[Sai cha/Legends|killing]] Vizsla after a fierce struggle, Maul claimed the Darksaber as his own, and with it leadership over Death Watch. Only [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, Maul was forced to use the Darksaber in a [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|duel]] against his former [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who sought to bring the renegade Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] back under his control. Despite wielding the Darksaber alongside his own red-bladed [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Maul was defeated and subdued by Sidious.

==Description==
{{Quote|Because we were willing to die for our cause, we became the Death Watch, led by the Secret Mandalores. To ensure we would be led by the most powerful, we decreed that any warrior could challenge the Secret Mandalore for leadership of Death Watch. And as our symbol of authority we chose the Darksaber, an ancient weapon liberated from the Jedi long ago.|[[Tor Vizsla]], on the iconic significance of the Darksaber|<ref name="TBHC" />}}
[[File:DarksaberRender.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The Darksaber]]
An ancient incarnation of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Darksaber was a unique weapon that produced a flat, [[Color/Legends|black]] blade<ref name="TMP" /> of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]].<ref name="EGtWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Thin and curved to a point,<ref name="TMP" /> a shape more similar to a metal [[Sword/Legends|sword]] than contemporary lightsabers,<ref name="EGtWT" /> the Darksaber's black blade was a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long and appeared to draw in the very light and color around it<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> like a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> This effect gave the Darksaber a faint aura of white light around the edges of its blade,<ref name="TMP" /> and made looking at it for an extended period uncomfortable.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />

The [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of the Darksaber was thin and rectangular, and long enough to be grasped with two [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. It featured an angled crossguard and a serrated [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]].<ref name="TMP" /> When the Darksaber's blade was activated by pressing its [[activation stud]],<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> the hum and pitch of the blade was notably higher than contemporary lightsabers,<ref name="SoR" /> and the blade gave off a sound like a whistle when it was swung through [[Atmosphere/Legends|the air]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> When the Darksaber came into contact with another object or a lightsaber blade, the Darksaber blade screeched, and the white aura that surrounded the black core of the blade crackled.<ref name="SoR" />

==History==
{{Quote|I claim this sword, and my rightful place as ''leader'' of Death Watch.|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], after slaying Pre Vizsla|<ref name="SoR" />}}
Ancient and powerful,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> the Darksaber had been kept in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="TMP" /> on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEA" /> When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] suffered a blow to its influence, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] from the [[Clan Vizsla/Legends|Vizsla clan]] raided the Temple and stole the Darksaber from within. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], the Darksaber was passed down through the clan's generations, and became responsible for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TMP" /> By [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]],<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the Darksaber had come into the possession of [[Tor Vizsla]].<ref name="TBHC" />

[[File:DarkSaber_original.jpg|thumb|right|225px|[[Tor Vizsla]] brandishing the Darksaber]]
As Tor Vizsla assembled to him a group of malcontents<ref name="OpenSeasons1">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 1|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 1]]</ref> who resented [[Jaster Mereel]], the ruling [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]—traditional leader of the Mandalorian clans—for his attempts to rein in their lifestyles of unaccountability,<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> and promised them the downfall of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] they so despised, he formed a splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. Taking his place as their leader, a [[Secret Mandalore]] in opposition to both the traditional ''Mand'alor'' chosen by the warrior clans and [[Anti-Mandalore|the one]] appointed by the peaceful New Mandalorians, Vizsla made the Darksaber a symbol of his authority as leader. Vizsla kept ownership of the Darksaber through the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]] between Death Watch and Jaster Mereel's [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[True Mandalorians]], as well as the subsequent [[Great Clan Wars/Legends|Great Clan Wars]] that erupted<ref name="TBHC" /> on the Mandalorians' cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, Vizsla was [[Showdown on Corellia|killed]] by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="OpenSeasons4">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 4|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 4]]</ref> not long after the end of the Great Clan Wars,<ref name="TBHC" /> and the Darksaber passed into the possession of Tor Vizsla's clan kinsman, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].<ref name="NewBattlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

By the time the Galactic Republic clashed with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] of the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in a [[Galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Pre Vizsla had taken his place as the leader of the Death Watch,<ref name="TMP" /> succeeding Tor as the new Secret Mandalore.<ref name="TBHC" /> Publicly the benevolent New Mandalorian [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Mandalore's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]],<ref name="TMP" /> bequeathed to the stewardship of Clan Vizsla after the end of the Great Clan Wars,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Pre Vizsla secretly kept the Darksaber in his possession while plotting against the New Mandalorians' latest leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Vizsla took to keeping the inactive Darksaber hilt slung on his back, just behind his right shoulder.<ref name="TMP" />

[[File:Kenobi_vs_Vizsla.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] wielding the Darksaber in a duel against [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]]]
When the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]—a friend and former lover of Duchess Kryze—uncovered Death Watch's [[Death Watch hideout|hidden base]] among Concordia's [[Concordian mines/Legends|''beskar'' mines]],<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Vizsla [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|engaged]] Kenobi in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] as his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] evacuated<ref name="TMP" /> aboard their [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class transports]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Vizsla's [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|skill]] with the Darksaber allowed him to battle Kenobi evenly for a time before Vizsla resorted to calling upon the aid of his Death Watch subordinates, who opened [[Missile/Legends|fire]] on Kenobi and forced the Jedi Master to retreat.<ref name="TMP" />

Stripped of his governance and driven from the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]],<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Pre Vizsla led the Death Watch to settle on the [[Water/Legends|snowy]] world of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]]. The Mandalorian rogues eventually made contact with the young [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], and agreed to an alliance in order to bring down the leader of the Confederacy of Independent [[Star system/Legends|Systems]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], as retribution for the count's trespasses against both parties. Not long after Bonteri arrived on Carlac in the company of the undercover Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Vizsla unleashed his Death Watch forces on the native [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] people that had bristled under the Mandalorians' occupation. Personally [[Shiak|killing]] the [[Tryla/Legends|granddaughter]] of the Ming Po [[Pieter/Legends|chieftain]] with the Darksaber, Vizsla earned the ire of Padawan Tano, who broke her cover and attempted to protect the Ming Po from Death Watch, only to be subdued and [[Fibercord/Legends|captured]]. At the Death Watch's [[Carlac Death Watch camp/Legends|camp]], Vizsla made to execute Tano with the Darksaber before his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]], but the Jedi was able to escape her bindings with the aid of [[R2-D2/Legends|droid companion]], and engaged Vizsla in a [[Battle on Carlac/Legends|heated duel]]. The two fought evenly matched for a time, but Tano slashed Vizsla's [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] with her lightsaber, forcing Vizsla to discard it before the ruptured [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]] could explode; with Vizsla temporarily distracted, Tano fled the Death Watch encampment and departed Carlac with Bonteri.<ref name="AFiN">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>

[[File:VizslaDuelsAhsokaOnCarlac-AFIN.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pre Vizsla using the Darksaber to battle [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]]]
With Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military forces]] moving to combat the Death Watch presence on Carlac,<ref name="CWA">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref> Vizsla led the renegade sect to establish their operations on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], while passing over the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], Death Watch encountered a seemingly derelict [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] floating in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Docking with the pod, Vizsla carved open the door with the Darksaber, and discovered the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] unconscious inside. Vizsla ordered the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to be returned to Zanbar, where once they were conscious and their wounds healed, the three entered into an alliance of mutual benefit: the Sith would aid Death Watch's attempts to depose the New Mandalorians, while the Death Watch backed [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul's plan of vengeance against Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi,<ref name="Eminence">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref> who had nearly [[Sai tok/Legends|killed]] Maul over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> To this end, they assembled an [[Shadow Collective/Legends|army]] of criminals from the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. On [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], negotiations for an alliance with the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] failed, and in the resulting [[Mission to Nal Hutta/Legends|skirmish]], Vizsla cut down numerous [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] soldiers in the Hutts' service using the Darksaber. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Maul and Vizsla were then able to force the cooperation of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]] by threatening<ref name="Eminence" /> the ''[[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] lorda'' [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> and put their plan to bring about the downfall of the New Mandalorian government into action.<ref name="Eminence" />

On Mandalore, the criminal collective began a chaotic assault on the New Mandalorian capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], against which the city's [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|police units]] proved ineffective.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> As the people called upon their leaders for aid, Death Watch appeared to the Sundari populace with a pledge to protect them. Death Watch troops clashed with their secret criminal allies, and Pre Vizsla personally used the Darksaber in a staged battle against Savage Opress, defeating and arresting the Zabrak [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]]. Winning the support of the people for their role in defeating the criminal threat, Death Watch was lauded as heroes, the Duchess Satine Kryze was deposed, and Pre Vizsla ascended to take her place.<ref name="SoR" />

[[File:Pre_vs_Maul-SOR.png|thumb|left|250px|In a duel for the leadership of Death Watch, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] wields the Darksaber against [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].]]
With his own goals met, Pre Vizsla betrayed his Sith allies and had them [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]]. However, Maul and Opress soon escaped their [[Prison/Legends|confines]], and in the process, recruited the services of their fellow [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]]—the former New Mandalorian [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Storming the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]], Darth Maul challenged Vizsla to a deadly duel for leadership of Death Watch. Wielding the Darksaber, Vizsla battled Maul in a furious bout that left the palace [[Throne/Legends|throne]] room scarred. Despite making use of a myriad of weapons his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] had equipped, Vizsla was eventually disarmed and defeated, only to be summarily [[Sai cha/Legends|executed]] with his own Darksaber by Maul's hand. Maul then claimed the Darksaber as his own,<ref name="SoR" /> and with it—in accordance Death Watch's own code of honor<ref name="TBHC" />—proclaimed himself Death Watch's new leader. Several members of the Mandalorian group followed the lead of the deceased Vizsla's lieutenant, [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]], and refused to follow the command of a non-Mandalorian. Darksaber in hand, Maul ordered the dissenters killed, forcing the breakaway group to fight their way out of the palace. Almec was reinstated as the Prime [[Minister]] of the New Mandalorians, a puppet ruler for Maul who,<ref name="SoR" /> with the Darksaber now in his possession, was the Death Watch's new Secret Mandalore.<ref name="TBHC" />

Soon after, Maul lured Obi-Wan Kenobi to Sundari, where he captured the Jedi Master in the act of attempting to free Duchess Kryze. Returning to the palace with both prisoners, Maul chose to take his vengeance on Kenobi by killing his former love before his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], stabbing Kryze through the abdomen with the Darksaber. After allowing Kenobi to watch as she perished, Maul had him imprisoned to live with his emotional suffering, though the Jedi was able to escape with the assistance of Bo-Katan and her [[Nite Owls/Legends|rebellious group]].<ref name="Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

[[File:ShallWeDance-TL.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] dual-wields the Darksaber and his lightsaber against [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].]]
Amid the chaos the Death Watch offshoots wrought in escorting Kenobi out of Sundari and off of Mandalore, Darth Maul's former [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], arrived in Sundari to put an end to his renegade former apprentice's actions. Confronting Maul and his own [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] Savage Opress in the Sundari throne room, Lord Sidious engaged both combatants in a two-against-one [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|duel]] that soon spilled out into the [[Sundari Royal Palace plaza/Legends|palace plaza]]. Initially making use of only [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|his own lightsaber]], after Sidious struck down Opress on the palace steps, Maul took up the Darksaber in concert with his own blade, and dual-wielded both weapons against the Dark Lord. Even with the added boon of the Darksaber, Maul proved unable to beat his former master in combat; Sidious disarmed and [[Telekinesis/Legends|violently]] [[Force lightning/Legends|subdued]] Maul with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Darksaber was cast away as he brought the defeated Maul to heel before releasing deadly amounts of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at his defeated foe.<ref name="Lawless" />

[[File:2ndBattleDathomir-SoD-4.png|left|thumb|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] wields the darksaber against [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], while his [[Talzin/Legends|mother]] (Inside [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] body) fights [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]].]]
Darth Maul was taken prisoner by his former master and then constantly tortured by Count Dooku and his separatist forces however Maul's Mandalorian followers would free him, then Maul recovered the Darksaber and used it to fight [[Grievous|General Grievous]] and his droid forces, though in the end Maul was forced to order a retreat after his forces had been overwhelmed by the droid army's might. Maul would then ask for aid the his allies in the criminal underworld and also contacted with [[Talzin|Mother Talzin]]. Maul plan to lure Count Dooku and his forces into a trap failed after his allies abandoned him because they didn't trust in his plan and the sudden appeareance of Darth Sidious, then in an intense fight Maul used the Darksaber to fend off General Grievous while Talzin (inside Dooku's body) dueled Palpatine, they were overwhelmed and after Dooku recovered control of his body Talzin decided to sacrifice herself to protect Maul who would be pulled into a ship by his Mandalorian followers, Talzin then would be slain for good by Grievous.<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir">''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It has a crackle of electricity; it's kind of like a more ancient version of a lightsaber, and it's inferred in the episode that it's really one of a kind and that Pre Vizsla's ancestors stole it from the Jedi in the days of the Old Republic. So it's got all this neat history attached to it right away, and it sounds different.|[[Dave Filoni]]|<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ign.com/articles/2010/01/28/star-wars-are-you-ready-for-the-mandalorians|text=Star Wars: Are You Ready for the Mandalorians?|author=Eric Goldman|date=2010-01-28|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivedate=20130210173031}}</ref>}}
The Darksaber first appeared in the twelfth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]]. Entitled "[[The Mandalore Plot]]," the episode premiered [[January 29]], [[2010]], and featured the Darksaber being wielded by the newly introduced character of Pre Vizsla, who provided a brief backstory for the blade.<ref name="TMP" /> Though it had originally been intended for Pre Vizsla to fight using a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]],<ref name="IGN" /> a familiar weapon in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]],<ref name="EGtWT" /> the vibroblade was later modified at the request of [[George Lucas]], with the creative team altering the blade into an archaic, black-bladed lightsaber they deemed the Darksaber.<ref name="IGN" />

The Darksaber was subsequently featured in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars video games|online game]],<ref name="CWA" /> as well as ''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Lost Temple]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]]. It continued to appear alongside its owner Pre Vizsla in the animated ''The Clone Wars'' television series as well, including the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth-season]] episode "[[A Friend in Need]],"<ref name="AFiN" /> and the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth-season]] episodes "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]],"<ref name="Eminence" /> "[[Shades of Reason]],"<ref name="SoR" /> and "[[The Lawless]]."<ref name="Lawless" />
